items: 【Enhance Focus and Coordination】These youth bow and arrow set provides an engaging and challenging activity that helps children develop essential skills not only just aiming and shooting, but also promotes focus, patience, and hand-eye coordination via the most fun and interactive way. They will learn to concentrate, improve their aim, and develop a sense of discipline while enjoying the excitement of hitting targets.

【Safe for Kids & Easy to Use】Equipped with soft suction cup tips, the arrows can be firmly attached to the target or glass smooth surface. Such a brilliant design making it an ultra safe toy for kids aged 3 and above. Besides, the bow is lightweight and easy to handle, ensuring a comfortable grip for small hands. The built-in LED lights of the bow making it a cool toy as well as perfect toy for children to enjoy in rooms with low light or in dark environments (note: batteries are not included).

【Durable & High-Quality Made】Made from durable materials, youth archery bow is designed to resist impact and provide long-lasting performance. The adjustable string design of the toy bow enhances its versatility for users of different ages and body types, providing improved safety and control as well as boosting the overall durability and long-lasting quality of the entire set. The arrows are meticulously crafted with precision, featuring robust shafts designed for prolonged and repeated use.

【Portable and Easy-Carrying】These archery sets include 2 bows, 20 arrows, 2 quivers, and 1 standing target. With their compact size and lightweight construction, they are designed to be effortlessly carried and transported. Whether you're planning a trip to the park, going on camping adventures, or enjoying family outings, these archery sets are the ideal companion. Encourage your young archer to explore new environments and discover the joy of archery wherever they go.

【Outdoor/Indoor Fun & Perfect Gift】Comes with a standing target that can also be hung on the wall, these archery set is an excellent choice to enjoy both outdoor and indoor fun by placing it on backyard, garden, camping area, playground, living room, game room, archery field. It is an brilliant gift choice for boys, girls, kids, your son, daughter, nephews on various occasion like Birthday, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, etc, or reward for good behavior.
